accueil.intro: I'm 19, I live in Annecy, France, and I'm in my second year of BUT Informatique (Bachelor's Degree of Technology in Computer Science) at IUT d'Annecy. Alongside my studies, I am launching my freelance web development business. I am currently looking for an internship.
accueil.badge: Looking for an internship & a work-study position
accueil.casquettesTitre: Two hats at the same time
accueil.formationTexte: Second year of BUT Informatique at IUT d'Annecy, Université Savoie Mont Blanc: software development, databases, systems and networks, project management.
accueil.productionTexte: Freelance web developer: I design websites, deploy them on a server I manage myself and keep them up to date.

parcours.intro: I am in my second year of BUT Informatique at IUT d'Annecy. At the same time, I build websites as a freelancer: what I learn in class, I apply to real projects.

freelance.texte: Designing, hosting and maintaining websites for small businesses, including quotes, contracts and client relations. I designed and administer the hosting server on my own: an OVHcloud VPS running Debian, Docker containers on isolated networks, and Bash scripts for backups, deployment and security audits.

benevolt.lieu: University team project (4 members) · IUT d'Annecy, France
benevolt.texte: Fictional project modelled on Benevolt, a platform that matches volunteers with associations. I wrote the use cases for the Association and Administration areas, then the SQL constraints and test data for the PostgreSQL database generated from the data model (MCD). Development with Laravel, using Scrum, starts soon.

ogplay.lieu: University team project (6 members) · IUT d'Annecy, France
ogplay.texte: Business simulation game of a food-processing company. We modelled the production chains as graphs, then optimised the production plan with linear programming: 75.9% more profit than a greedy approach. Results presented orally.

mobalpa.lieu: University team project (3 members) · IUT d'Annecy, France
mobalpa.texte: Desktop quote management application for a fictional kitchen company modelled on Mobalpa, with two roles: sales representative and store manager. I built the navigation menu and the four main screens, factored the interface styles, then developed client management (list, search, creation, deletion) and role management, with a catalogue CRUD restricted to the manager.

parcours.butIntro: The degree is built around six skills, developed over the three years. My specialisation track:

realiser.texte: Design, code, test and integrate an IT solution.

optimiser.texte: Choose the right data structures and algorithms, measure and improve.

administrer.texte: Install, configure and secure machines, networks and services.

gerer.texte: Design databases, query them and make use of the data.

conduire.texte: Analyse a need, plan a project and track its progress.

collaborer.texte: Fit into a team, communicate and share the workload.

projets.intro: University projects from my BUT and what I build in my free time.
projets.vide: No project uses this technology yet.

freelance.intro: Alongside my studies, I build websites for clients: from the first discussion to going live, and then the updates.

besoin.texte: We talk about the project: what the website is for, who it is for and what content it needs.

developper.texte: I build the website in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, fast and easy to read on mobile as well as on desktop.

enLigne.texte: I deploy the website on a server I manage, with Nginx and Docker.

fairevivre.texte: Changes go through Git and are live with a single command.

freelance.apportTexte: For a company hosting me as an intern or a work-study student, it means working with someone who has already delivered projects in real-world conditions.

boutEnBout.texte: From the first conversation with the client to the live website, I handle every step.

production.texte: Server, containers, Nginx configuration, updates: I deploy what I code myself.

clients.texte: Concrete requests, deadlines and feedback to take into account.

freelance.bandeTexte: Tell me about your project in a few lines and I will get back to you to discuss it.

contact.intro: An internship, a work-study position or a website project? The easiest way is to email me.
